provenance.source: Maximum of saturated raw frames in this library. The sensor is 14-bit, so a clipped frame reaches 16383. Copied from the CAMERA_CEILING_ADU comment in pipelines/stacking/exposure_saturation.py.
Pipeline default: just under the 16-bit maximum of 65535, applied to every camera. See measure_saturated_pixel_fraction in pipelines/shared/quality/quality_metrics.py.

notes: OPEN QUESTION: this threshold sits above the clip ceiling of 16383, so a saturated pixel could never reach it. If raw D5300 frames are read at their native 14-bit scale, saturation checks that use the threshold would always report none. Not yet checked against real D5300 frames, and the value is kept as it was so that behaviour does not change during the profile refactor.
